name: NetMirror
description: NetMirror (netmirror.center) - Netflix-style catalog: Bollywood, Hollywood, Anime & Reality TV, heavy on Hindi content. Signed direct-file servers per title/episode (R2 + quality-labeled MP4s, up to 1080p). v3: all servers - Direct + Hub flows in parallel with 6 mirror failover hosts, works on movies with broken embeds. Verified live.
